thag6.10:1.1: Yadā navo pabbajito jātiyā sattavassiko, iddhiyā abhibhotvāna pannagindaṃ mahiddhikaṃ || ||
thag6.10:2.1: upajjhayassa udakaṃ Anotattā mahāsarā āharāmi, tato disvā maṃ satthā etad abravī: || ||
thag6.10:3.1: Sāriputta imaṃ passa āgacchantaṃ kumārakaṃ udakumbhakam ādāya ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ. || ||
thag6.10:4.1: pāsādikena vattena kalyāṇairiyāpatho sāmaṇero 'nuruddhassa iddhiyā ca visārado, || ||
thag6.10:5.1: ājāniyena ājañño sādhunā sādhukārito vinīto Anuruddhena katakiccena sikkhito: || ||
thag6.10:6.1: so patvā pāramaṃ santiṃ sacchikatvā akuppataṃ sāmaṇero sa Sumano mā maṃ jaññā 'ti icchatīti. || || Sumano thero.
